error.message: Design review: nominal contact aligns the TCP origin, not a calibrated finger or pad. This is not a tool runtime exception.

diagnosis.root_cause: No representation of the intended physical contact feature, its aperture-dependent pose, or contact patch.
diagnosis.episode_causality: Unresolved: contact arrival timed out before formal press. No evidence yet distinguishes finger-gap misalignment from collision, perception error, or controller behavior.

resolution.notes: Warnings and unknown contact evidence are exposed. Physical geometry is not repaired; no offset or press depth was invented.
